", "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "data:image/jpeg;base64,"];
const YHN_LEAVE_POLICY_FIXED='data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,'+encodeURIComponent(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="900" viewBox="0 0 1200 900">
<rect width="1200" height="900" fill="white"/>
<rect x="6" y="6" width="1188" height="888" fill="none" stroke="#10a8e8" stroke-width="6"/>
<rect x="15" y="15" width="1170" height="870" fill="none" stroke="#10a8e8" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="24" y="24" width="1152" height="852" fill="none" stroke="#10a8e8" stroke-width="3"/>
<style>.t{font-family:DFKai-SB,BiauKai,"標楷體","Noto Serif TC",serif;fill:#111}.title{font-size:56px}.body{font-size:27px}.red{fill:#ff1717}.blue{fill:#11a8ef}</style>
<text class="t title" x="600" y="145" text-anchor="middle">請假規定</text>
<text class="t body" x="92" y="278"><tspan class="red">• 事　假：</tspan><tspan>需</tspan><tspan class="blue">事前提出</tspan><tspan>，若與</tspan><tspan class="red">工作互為衝突</tspan><tspan>時，得不同意。</tspan></text>
<text class="t body" x="92" y="320"><tspan class="red">• 病　假：</tspan><tspan>醫師</tspan><tspan class="blue">診斷書</tspan><tspan>或</tspan><tspan class="blue">就醫證明書</tspan><tspan>。</tspan></text>
<text class="t body" x="92" y="362"><tspan class="red">• 喪　假：</tspan><tspan>訃聞喪帖、死亡證明書影本及戶口名簿影本。</tspan></text>
<text class="t body" x="92" y="404"><tspan class="red">• 婚　假：</tspan><tspan>喜帖、結婚證書或戶口名簿影本。</tspan></text>
<text class="t body" x="92" y="446"><tspan class="red">• 產　假：</tspan><tspan>出生證明或診斷書。</tspan></text>
<text class="t body" x="92" y="488"><tspan class="red">• 產檢假：</tspan><tspan>媽媽手冊封面及產檢日期內頁影本。</tspan></text>
<text class="t body" x="92" y="530"><tspan class="red">• 陪產假：</tspan><tspan>出生證明。</tspan></text>
<text class="t body" x="92" y="572"><tspan class="red">• 公　假：</tspan><tspan>依事實提供證明，如外訓課程表、教育召集令、原住民族歲時祭儀公告。</tspan></text>
<text class="t body" x="92" y="630"><tspan>• 事先預知假別應至少於</tspan><tspan class="blue" font-size="48">3日前</tspan><tspan class="red">告知案家及督導員</tspan><tspan>，取得同意後，始完成請假</tspan></text>
<text class="t body" x="128" y="670">手續</text>
<text class="t body" x="92" y="720"><tspan>• 若遇當天臨時緊急狀況或是身體不適時，須立即</tspan><tspan class="red">告知案家及回報督導員</tspan><tspan>，以利</tspan></text>
<text class="t body" x="128" y="760">後續處理，並於事後告知案家及督導員補班事宜。</text>
<text class="t body" x="92" y="812"><tspan class="blue">• 無故缺勤</tspan><tspan>或未經督導員同意缺勤者、休假逾期而未續假者視同</tspan><tspan class="red">曠職</tspan><tspan>。</tspan></text>
</svg>`);
YHN_PPT_SLIDES[20]=YHN_LEAVE_POLICY_FIXED;
let yhnPptIndex=0;
function pptShow(i){
  yhnPptIndex=(i+YHN_PPT_SLIDES.length)%YHN_PPT_SLIDES.length;
  const img=document.getElementById('pptSlide'); if(img) img.src=YHN_PPT_SLIDES[yhnPptIndex];
  const c=document.getElementById('pptCount'); if(c) c.textContent=(yhnPptIndex+1)+' / '+YHN_PPT_SLIDES.length;
  const z=document.getElementById('pptZoomImg'); if(z) z.src=YHN_PPT_SLIDES[yhnPptIndex];
}
function pptPrev(){pptShow(yhnPptIndex-1)}
function pptNext(){pptShow(yhnPptIndex+1)}
function pptOpen(){
  let z=document.getElementById('pptZoom');
  if(!z){
    z=document.createElement('div'); z.id='pptZoom'; z.className='ppt-zoom';
    z.innerHTML='<button onclick="pptClose()">×</button><img id="pptZoomImg" alt="投影片放大">';
    z.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.id==='pptZoom') pptClose();});
    document.body.appendChild(z);
  }
  document.getElementById('pptZoomImg').src=YHN_PPT_SLIDES[yhnPptIndex];
  z.classList.add('open');
}
function pptClose(){const z=document.getElementById('pptZoom'); if(z) z.classList.remove('open')}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowLeft') pptPrev(); if(e.key==='ArrowRight') pptNext(); if(e.key==='Escape') pptClose();});
</script><div aria-label="翻頁控制" class="flipbar"><button onclick="bookPrev()" type="button">‹</button><span class="count" id="bookCount">1 / 1</span><button onclick="bookNext()" type="button">›</button><button aria-label="翻頁聲開關" class="sound" id="soundBtn" onclick="toggleFlipSound()" type="button">🔊</button></div><div aria-label="簡報全螢幕播放" id="pptFullscreen" role="dialog"><button class="fsClose" onclick="pptFullscreenClose()" type="button">×</button><div class="fsSlideWrap"><img alt="簡報全螢幕投影片" id="pptFsImg"/></div><div class="fsControls"><button onclick="pptPrevFs()" type="button">上一頁</button><span id="pptFsCount">1 / 90</span><button onclick="pptNextFs()" type="button">下一頁</button></div></div><script>
(function(){
  const book=document.querySelector('.book');
  const pages=[...document.querySelectorAll('.book>.page')];
  let current=0, soundOn=true, lastSoundIndex=-1, lastTap=0;
  let audioCtx=null;
  function updateCount(){ const c=document.getElementById('bookCount'); if(c)c.textContent=(current+1)+' / '+pages.length; }
  function pageWidth(){return Math.max(1,book.clientWidth)}
  function gotoPage(i,play=true){
    i=Math.max(0,Math.min(pages.length-1,i));
    if(i===current && !play) return;
    current=i; book.scrollTo({left:i*pageWidth(),behavior:'smooth'}); updateCount(); if(play) flipSound();
  }
  window.bookPrev=()=>gotoPage(current-1,true); window.bookNext=()=>gotoPage(current+1,true);
  function ensureAudio(){
    try{audioCtx=audioCtx||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(); if(audioCtx.state==='suspended') audioCtx.resume();}catch(e){}
  }
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown',ensureAudio,{once:true,passive:true});
  document.addEventListener('touchstart',ensureAudio,{once:true,passive:true});
  function flipSound(){
    if(!soundOn || lastSoundIndex===current) return; lastSoundIndex=current;
    try{
      ensureAudio();
      const dur=.16, sr=audioCtx.sampleRate, buf=audioCtx.createBuffer(1,Math.floor(sr*dur),sr), d=buf.getChannelData(0);
      for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++){const t=i/d.length; d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*(1-t)*(.18+Math.sin(t*Math.PI)*.12)}
      const src=audioCtx.createBufferSource(), gain=audioCtx.createGain(), filt=audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
      filt.type='bandpass'; filt.frequency.value=1250; filt.Q.value=.7; gain.gain.value=.55;
      src.buffer=buf; src.connect(filt); filt.connect(gain); gain.connect(audioCtx.destination); src.start();
    }catch(e){}
  }
  window.toggleFlipSound=()=>{soundOn=!soundOn; const b=document.getElementById('soundBtn'); if(b)b.textContent=soundOn?'🔊':'🔇'; if(soundOn){lastSoundIndex=-1;flipSound();}};
  let settleTimer;
  book.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{clearTimeout(settleTimer); settleTimer=setTimeout(()=>{const i=Math.round(book.scrollLeft/pageWidth()); if(i!==current){current=i; updateCount(); flipSound();}},90)},{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('resize',()=>book.scrollTo({left:current*pageWidth(),behavior:'auto'}));
  document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(document.getElementById('pptFullscreen')?.classList.contains('open')) return; if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')bookPrev(); if(e.key==='ArrowRight')bookNext();});
  // Double click / double tap any image to zoom.
  function zoomImage(img){
    if(img.id==='pptFsImg') return;
    if(typeof openZoom==='function'){openZoom(img); const zi=document.querySelector('#zoom img'); if(zi)zi.classList.remove('zoomed');}
  }
  document.addEventListener('dblclick',e=>{const img=e.target.closest('img'); if(img) zoomImage(img)});
  document.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{const img=e.target.closest('img'); if(!img)return; const now=Date.now(); if(now-lastTap<320){e.preventDefault();zoomImage(img);} lastTap=now;},{passive:false});
  document.addEventListener('dblclick',e=>{if(e.target.matches('#zoom img')) e.target.classList.toggle('zoomed')});
  // PPT full screen: works as real viewport overlay everywhere, and asks native fullscreen where supported.
  window.pptFullscreenOpen=async function(){
    const o=document.getElementById('pptFullscreen'); if(!o)return;
    document.getElementById('pptFsImg').src=YHN_PPT_SLIDES[yhnPptIndex];
    document.getElementById('pptFsCount').textContent=(yhnPptIndex+1)+' / '+YHN_PPT_SLIDES.length;
    o.classList.add('open');
    try{if(o.requestFullscreen) await o.requestFullscreen(); else if(o.webkitRequestFullscreen) o.webkitRequestFullscreen();}catch(e){}
  };
  window.pptFullscreenClose=async function(){
    const o=document.getElementById('pptFullscreen'); if(o)o.classList.remove('open');
    try{if(document.fullscreenElement) await document.exitFullscreen(); else if(document.webkitFullscreenElement&&document.webkitExitFullscreen) document.webkitExitFullscreen();}catch(e){}
  };
  window.pptPrevFs=function(){pptShow(yhnPptIndex-1); document.getElementById('pptFsImg').src=YHN_PPT_SLIDES[yhnPptIndex]; document.getElementById('pptFsCount').textContent=(yhnPptIndex+1)+' / '+YHN_PPT_SLIDES.length; flipSound();};
  window.pptNextFs=function(){pptShow(yhnPptIndex+1); document.getElementById('pptFsImg').src=YHN_PPT_SLIDES[yhnPptIndex]; document.getElementById('pptFsCount').textContent=(yhnPptIndex+1)+' / '+YHN_PPT_SLIDES.length; flipSound();};
  // Swipe inside fullscreen presentation.
  let fsX=null; const fso=document.getElementById('pptFullscreen');
  fso.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{fsX=e.touches[0].clientX},{passive:true});
  fso.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{if(fsX==null)return; const dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-fsX; if(Math.abs(dx)>55){dx<0?pptNextFs():pptPrevFs()} fsX=null;},{passive:true});
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',()=>{if(!document.fullscreenElement) document.getElementById('pptFullscreen')?.classList.remove('open')});
  updateCount();
})();
</script></body></html>
